portInfo.description: Westerplatte berth is the history-first landing: authority text puts the Westerplatte monument and Wisłoujście fortress within a short walk. Main Town is a transfer, not a pier stroll.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Nabrzeże Obrońców Westerplatte — Port Gdańsk — entrance / Westerplatte
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Authority: about 15 minutes berth→centre by road; licensed taxis on cruise berths.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Authority: about 15 minutes berth→centre by road; licensed taxis on cruise berths.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not treat Main Town as walkable from the entrance berths.
